title: Drake Maye tells campers his lesson from the Super Bowl is "I have to play better"

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Drake Maye tells campers his lesson from the Super Bowl is "I have to play better"
sources.description: Patriots quarterback Drake Maye hosted three football camps last week and told the assembled children that he takes responsibility for New England's loss in Super Bowl LX.
